Initially H contains M and S. tick0 detach H; tick1 install V; tick2 insert S,V; ticks3-6 idle; tick7 withdraw S,V; tick8 remove V; tick9 idle. Actions finish next boundary. Joint capacity is min(4,4)=4 by boundary3, maintained for hold ticks3-6; releases complete boundary9. Use no pins, concurrent non-pin assembly, outside resource or unsupported operation. H remains disassembled, M free. Capacity support is J06, prerequisites J02/J03, invariant J01/J09/J12. Do not assume any Q theta or empirical performance.
